questiedb.name: Find OOX-09/HL!
objectivesText: Take the distress beacon to Oglethorpe's homing robot at the head of the river in the Hinterlands, near Skulk Rock.

questiedb.name: Rescue OOX-09/HL!
objectivesText: Escort OOX-09/HL to the shoreline beyond Overlook Cliff, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.

objectivesText: Speak with High Thane Falstad Wildhammer at Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands.

objectivesText: Kill 10 Green Sludges and 10 Jade Oozes, and then report back to Fraggar Thundermantle in Aerie Peak.

objectivesText: Bring 5 Troll Tribal Necklaces to Fraggar Thundermantle in Aerie Peak.

questiedb.name: Witherbark Cages
objectivesText: Check the cages at the two Witherbark villages, then return to Gryphon Master Talonaxe.

questiedb.name: The Altar of Zul
objectivesText: Check the top of the Altar of Zul, then return to Gryphon Master Talonaxe.

questiedb.name: Thadius Grimshade
objectivesText: Bring Sharpbeak's Feather to Thadius Grimshade in the Blasted Lands.

objectivesText: Recover 10 bottles of Hinterlands Honey Ripple from the crates located around the abandoned Horde base in Skulk Rock.

questiedb.name: Ripple Recovery
objectivesText: Talk to Gilveradin Sunchaser; his camp is located in the Hinterlands.

questiedb.name: Return to Fel'Zerul
objectivesText: Return to Fel'Zerul in Stonard.

objectivesText: Escort Rin'ji out of the Quel'Danil Lodge, then find his hidden secret at the Overlook Cliffs to the east.

objectivesText: Oran Snakewrithe, a well known scholar on matters concerning the Witherbark trolls, may be able to decipher the tablet. She is known to reside within the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.

objectivesText: Gather Witherbark Skulls and place on Nimboya's Pike. Place Nimboya's Laden Pike at one of the Witherbark Villages in the Hinterlands, then return to Nimboya in Stranglethorn.

objectivesText: Bring Faranell's Parcel to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

questiedb.name: Lines of Communication
objectivesText: Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity wants you to travel to the Hinterlands and burn the Highvale Records, Highvale Report, and Highvale Notes.

questiedb.name: Snapjaws, Mon!
objectivesText: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 15 Saltwater Snapjaw turtles. Return to him when you have completed this task.

questiedb.name: Gammerita, Mon!
objectivesText: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill Gammerita and retrieve Katoom's Best Lure from her corpse.
Katoom mentioned that Gammerita hangs out on the coast with the other turtles.

questiedb.name: Stalking the Stalkers
objectivesText: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 10 Silvermane Stalkers and 10 Silvermane Howlers. Return to him once the task is complete.
Markhor mentioned that the wolves hide in the wilds of the Hinterlands.

questiedb.name: Hunt the Savages
objectivesText: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 20 Savage Owlbeasts. Return to him once the task is complete.
Markhor mentioned that the Savage Owlbeasts occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.

questiedb.name: Avenging the Fallen
objectivesText: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill a Razorbeak Skylord and retrieve its Skylord Plume. Return to him once the task is complete.
Markhor mentioned that the Razorbeak Skylord are a rare breed that tend to occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.

questiedb.name: Vilebranch Hooligans
objectivesText: Smith Slagtree at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Slagtree's Lost Tools. Return to him once this task is complete.
You recall Smith Slagtree mentioning that the tools might be at one of the Vilebranch temples in the northeastern region of the Hinterlands. You should also check Skulk Rock.

questiedb.name: Lard Lost His Lunch
objectivesText: Lard at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Lard's Lunch. Return to him when this task is complete.
Lard mentioned that he left it on the island to the north. Watch out for Vilebranch trolls.

questiedb.name: Message to the Wildhammer
objectivesText: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to slaughter 15 Highvale Outrunners, 15 Highvale Scouts, 15 Highvale Marksman and 15 Highvale Rangers. Return to him when this task is complete.
You can find the Highvale high elves at the Quel'Danil Lodge in the northwestern region of the Hinterlands.

questiedb.name: Another Message to the Wildhammer
objectivesText: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to bring him 10 Long Elegant Feathers from the gryphons that inhabit the Hinterlands. Return to him once this task is complete.
Gryphons are known to inhabit every region of the Hinterlands.

wowhead.name: The Final Message to the Wildhammer

questiedb.name: The Final Message to the Wildhammer
objectivesText: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to travel to Aerie Peak in the western region of the Hinterlands and place the Final Message to the Wildhammer by the well in the center of town. Return to him once this task is complete.
Beware of angry Wildhammer dwarves and unruly members of the Alliance.

allthethings.name: The Final Message to the Wildhammer

questiedb.name: Cannibalistic Cousins
objectivesText: Mystic Yayo'jin at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 30 Vilebranch Scalpers and 15 Vilebranch Soothsayers. Return to her when this task is complete.
Yayo'jin indicated that these trolls could be found near the Shaol'watha and Agol'watha temples in the north by northeastern region of the Hinterlands.

questiedb.name: Kidnapped Elder Torntusk!
objectivesText: Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to rescue her mate, Elder Torntusk, from Jintha'alor.
You have been told that he is being held prisoner atop Jintha'alor, the Vilebranch capital city located in the southern region of the Hinterlands.

questiedb.name: Recover the Key!
objectivesText: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to kill Hitah'ya the Keeper to get the Shackle Key to his bindings. Return to Elder Torntusk when you have recovered the key.

questiedb.name: Return to Primal Torntusk
objectivesText: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village with news of his rescue.

questiedb.name: Separation Anxiety
objectivesText: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover his twin brother's remains. Find and return Huntsman Malkhor's Skull and Huntsman Malkhor's Bones to Huntsman Markhor.

Markhor mentioned that his brother's remains were fed to the oozes and wolves of the Vilebranch. He also mentioned that there is a refuse pit filled with oozes in Jintha'alor as well as a wolf den. Both of these places are near the top of the temple.
